label: r1
issues: Build reads as a generic flat blob/jet, not a space shuttle at a glance
No distinct fuselage: body is a low flat slab instead of a rounded orbiter body with raised cabin
Missing black nose cone and black underbelly colour blocking
Tail fin is a tiny thin plate, not the tall swept vertical stabilizer of the concept
Only three small engine nozzles on the side rather than three main engines clustered at the rear
Wings lack the concept's delta shape with black leading/trailing edges
Excessive exposed studs and curved slopes give a rough, unfinished look unlike an official set
Red accent placed oddly on top spine rather than as small fuselage marking
Display stand is an opaque stack, not the clear angled stand of the concept
